updateErrors.missingSquirrel: GitHub Desktop can't check for updates because it is not running from an installed copy — there is no Update.exe above the folder it was launched from. A portable bundle is replaced by hand: install the GitHubDesktopL10nSetup program to get automatic updates.

updateErrors.timeout: GitHub Desktop was not able to check for updates due to a timeout. Ensure you have internet connectivity and try again.

testTokenExpirationDialog.title: Test Token Expiration
testTokenExpirationDialog.intro: Change Desktop's local access-token expiration, not GitHub's actual token lifetime. Overrides reset on token renewal or app restart. No credentials are displayed or saved by this dialog.
testTokenExpirationDialog.signInHint: Sign in to an account with a refreshable token to test expiration.
testTokenExpirationDialog.notRefreshable: This account does not have a refreshable token. Sign in again with short-lived tokens enabled to test expiration.
testTokenExpirationDialog.refreshHint: Ordinary requests refresh within 10 minutes of expiry. Copilot session creation refreshes within 61 minutes and 1 second. Renewal happens when authenticated work next requests a token.
testTokenExpirationDialog.readFailed: Unable to read token expiration. See the log for details.
testTokenExpirationDialog.chooseValid: Choose a valid token expiration date and time.
testTokenExpirationDialog.changeFailed: Unable to change token expiration. See the log for details.
